value.answer: This week, focus on Docker for about 8 hours. Start with Docker's Get Started guide to learn about images, containers, and volumes (2 hours). Then, practice running, inspecting, and stopping three containers from Docker Hub (2 hours). Finally, containerize the captioning API by adding a Dockerfile to your pod repo (4 hours). Your proof will be merging a PR with this Dockerfile. This hands-on approach will build your Docker skills effectively.
